annotations.title: List Meta automated rules, and which can raise spend

description: The automated rules on a Meta ad account — including ones made in Ads Manager — each with what it does in one sentence, whether it is ON, whether it CAN RAISE SPEND (canSpend, armingActions), whether its reach grows, and its scopeToken (what set_meta_ad_rule_status wants echoed back to switch on a rule that can raise spend). Also returns the ad account's caps on rules. Pass ruleId for one rule. Read-only. Free.

adAccountId.description: Meta ad account id (act_… or the bare number) from list_meta_ads; required — every rule lives on one ad account
